source.originalText:
Storm's Embrace
Starting at 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. Additionally, whenever you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, add your Wisdom modifier to the damage it deals.

cards.name: Tempest Raptor
cards.effect: Flight 60 ft, advantage on saves against wind/lightning while airborne. Claw 2d6+WIS lightning; wet target adds 1d4 once/shift for 1 Form Surge. After melee hit on you, attacker takes 1d6 lightning once/round; no repeated disarm chains.

source.originalText:
Tempest Raptor
Lightning Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 lightning damage
Flight: You have a flying speed of 60 ft.
Storm Shroud: You are surrounded by crackling electricity. Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d6 lightning damage.

cards.name: Thunderhorn Stag
cards.rangeAndTarget: Storm Hero; antlers 5 ft; teleport 30 ft
cards.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; after 20 ft approach first hit/turn also 2d8 thunder and CON save or Deafened through end next turn. Step Action teleport 30 ft, departure 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures CON save 2d8 thunder, half success. Sense natural storm approach 24 hours, no exact prediction of magical weather.

source.originalText:
Thunderhorn Stag
Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes 2d8 thunder damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn
Thunder Step: Once per transformation, you can teleport up to 30 ft. in a crack of thunder. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.
Weather Sense: You can sense approaching storms up to 24 hours in advance

cards.name: Eye of the Storm
cards.effect: Moderate ordinary weather inside sphere, no concentration; does not neutralize spell damage or magical hazards. For lightning/thunder spells choose up to M creatures to succeed initial save and take 0 if normally half; later independent pulses unchanged.

source.originalText:
Eye of the Storm
At 14th level, you gain the ability to create a zone of relative calm within a storm. As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you. Within the sphere, winds are reduced to gentle breezes, precipitation stops, and temperature becomes moderate. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and doesn't require concentration.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, taking no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

cards.name: Toxic Affinity
cards.effect: Resistance poison and advantage saves against Poisoned. Learn poison spray cantrip in addition to normal limit; use operational catalog effect/cost.

source.originalText:
Toxic Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. Additionally, you learn the poison spray cantrip if you don't already know it.

cards.name: Blighted Touch
cards.duration: Instant; Poisoned through end next turn
cards.effect: CON save:2d6 poison and Poisoned on failure, half damage/no Poisoned success. Poisoned gives disadvantage attacks/ability checks unless general condition glossary supersedes. Requires normal reach, not automatic touch through barriers.

source.originalText:
Blighted Touch
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel decay through your touch. As an action, you can touch a creature and force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't poisoned.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Withering Aura
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn in aura CON save or 1d6 poison, once/enemy/round. Mundane plants may wither; no damage to distant terrain or permanent poison stock. Ends on incapacitation.

source.originalText:
Withering Aura
Beginning at 6th level, you emanate an aura of decay. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing nonmagical plants within 10 feet of you to wither and die. Additionally, each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 poison damage.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Blight Elk
cards.effect: Antlers 2d8+WIS piercing, +1d4 poison once/turn against Poisoned. Enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d4 poison. Ground 10 ft around you is difficult terrain for enemies, no lasting thorns after movement/reversion.

source.originalText:
Blight Elk
Aura of Decay: Enemies that start their turn within 5 ft. of you take 1d4 poison damage
Antlers: Your antler attack deals 2d8 piercing damage
Toxic Presence: Plants wither in your presence, and water becomes tainted

cards.name: Tanglemaw
cards.rangeAndTarget: Thorns Hero; bite 5 ft; sense 30 ft
cards.effect: Bite 2d6+WIS piercing, STR save or Restrained through end next turn, Action escape DC. One melee attacker/round takes 1d4 piercing; one creature restrained by your bite takes 1d4 at start turn. Ground sense 30 ft same surface and advantage against Prone; no wall-penetrating identification.

source.originalText:
Tanglemaw
Bite: Your bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and causes the target to be restrained on a failed DC 14 Strength saving throw
Thorny Body: Creatures that touch you or hit you with a melee attack take 1d4 piercing damage
Root Network: You can sense the presence of creatures touching the ground within 30 ft. of you

cards.name: Master of Decay
cards.effect: Immune poison damage/Poisoned. Before one target rolls initial save against your poison spell impose-2. Replaces source automatic failures; cannot combine multiple identical penalty applications or negate immunity.

source.originalText:
Master of Decay
At 14th level, you gain immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals poison damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically fail their saving throws against the spell.

cards.name: Frost Magic
cards.effect: Learn ray of frost cantrip and ice knife always prepared, additional to normal counts, ordinary rank gates and costs.

source.originalText:
Frost Magic
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn the ray of frost cantrip if you don't already know it. Additionally, you learn the ice knife spell, which doesn't count against your number of druid spells known.

cards.name: Cold Resistance
cards.effect: Resistance cold and advantage on nonmagical extreme-cold exposure saves. No immunity to suffocation, ice entrapment or magical environmental damage.

source.originalText:
Cold Resistance
Starting at 2nd level, you gain resistance to cold damage. Additionally, you are naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in the environmental rules in Chapter 5.

cards.name: Winter's Embrace
cards.effect: Up to 3 enemies starting turn inside CON save or 1d6 cold and Speed-10 ft through end turn. Once/enemy/round; success no effect. Does not stack multiple slows or affect flying targets outside sphere.

source.originalText:
Winter's Embrace
Beginning at 6th level, you can surround yourself with an aura of biting cold. As a bonus action, you can activate this aura, causing each creature of your choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
This aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Snow Leopard
cards.effect: Claw 2d6+WIS cold, +1d4 once/turn against slowed foe. +5 Stealth on ice/snow and advantage on legal Hide there; source+10 reduced provisionally. Ignore ordinary ice/snow movement penalties, not magical restraining ice.

source.originalText:
Snow Leopard
Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d6 cold damage
Stealth: You gain a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in snowy or icy terrain
Frost Walk: You can move across icy surfaces without making ability checks and through snow without penalty

cards.name: Frost Wyrmling
cards.cost: One shift; breath one short-rest use
cards.rangeAndTarget: Winterfang Hero; 30 ft cone up to 3 creatures
cards.effect: AC normal+2, cold immunity. Claw 1d8+WIS cold. Breath 4d6 cold DEX half. One breath target may have cold resistance ignored once/shift for 1 Form Surge; immunity remains. No general physical resistance from cold terrain in this draft.

source.originalText:
Frost Wyrmling
Breath Weapon: As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of freezing air. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 4d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.
Scales of Ice: You gain a +2 bonus to AC
Cold Immunity: You are immune to cold damage

cards.name: Master of Winter
cards.effect: Cold immunity. Bounded winter weather invocation: create ordinary snow/sleet, difficult ground and sight limited 60 ft; no immediate damage or building collapse. This replaces undefined free high-rank control weather until an operational catalog version is selected; no RP, still 1 D.

source.originalText:
Master of Winter
At 14th level, you gain immunity to cold damage. Additionally, you can cast the control weather spell once without expending Resonance Points, but when you do so, you can only create weather conditions related to winter (such as snow, sleet, or freezing rain). Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Vermin Affinity
cards.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Circle; Tiny natural beasts within 10 ft
cards.effect: Communicate simple feelings/directions; normally indifferent, not compelled allies. Cannot extract facts beyond their senses or control swarms for extra actions.

source.originalText:
Vermin Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you can communicate simple ideas with tiny beasts such as rats, spiders, insects, and other vermin. Additionally, such creatures are indifferent to you by default rather than hostile.

cards.name: Swarm Summoning
cards.effect: Summon one swarm using shared companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP 2 L, Speed 30, melee attack PB+WIS for S d6 piercing. Bonus Action command, one damaging action across all pets. Tiny-body movement through 1 inchgaps; no separate attacks per insect.

source.originalText:
Swarm Summoning
Starting at 2nd level, you can summon a swarm of tiny creatures to aid you. As an action, you can summon a swarm of insects, rats, or spiders (your choice) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The swarm acts on your initiative count and obeys your verbal commands. It lasts for 10 minutes, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you dismiss it as a bonus action.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Plague Bearer
cards.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Circle; creature hit by your melee attack
cards.effect: CON save or Poisoned and 1d6 poison at start turn. Repeat end turn; ends on success or after 3 turns. No lasting epidemic or loss of character control.

source.originalText:
Plague Bearer
Beginning at 6th level, you can infect creatures with debilitating diseases. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature takes 1d6 poison damage at the start of each of its turns.
The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Carrion Rat King
cards.effect: Bite 1d8+WIS piercing+2d6 poison; CON save or Poisoned through end next turn. Immune disease/Poisoned, not poison damage. Summon Action creates one bounded engine swarm 1 minute, same command budget; replaces previous form swarm.

source.originalText:
Carrion Rat King
Poison Bite: Your bite attack deals 1d8 piercing damage plus 2d6 poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
Summon Swarm: As an action, you can summon a swarm of rats that acts on your initiative and obeys your mental commands. The swarm lasts for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.
Disease Immunity: You are immune to disease and the poisoned condition.

cards.name: Insect Broodmother
cards.rangeAndTarget: Rotshaper Hero; up to 2 swarms adjacent
cards.effect: AC normal+3, climb 30 walls/ceilings, bite 1d8+WIS piercing. On entry optional spend surge spawn 2 bounded shared profile swarms, both end with form, combined one commanded attack/turn. Once/shift for another Form Surge turn one crit against you into normal hit; no infinite insects.

source.originalText:
Insect Broodmother
Spawn Swarms: Each time you transform into this form, you can spawn 1d4 swarms of insects (CR 1/4 each) that act on your initiative and obey your mental commands. The swarms last until they are reduced to 0 hit points or until you revert to your normal form.
Chitinous Armor: You gain a +3 bonus to AC
Wall Crawling: You can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without making an ability check.

cards.name: Master of Vermin
cards.effect: Swarm form: own HP/AC, physical resistance, Speed 30, fit Tinygaps, natural attack S d6+WIS piercing. No flight unless choosing bats (flight 30), which forfeits physical resistance. Replacing a summoning spell's beast with swarm uses same single companion budget and paid spell, never multiplied dice/creatures.

source.originalText:
Master of Vermin
At 14th level, you gain the ability to transform into a swarm of tiny beasts (insects, rats, bats, or spiders) as if using your Shapeshifting feature. While in swarm form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can move through any space large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing.
Additionally, when you cast a spell that summons or creates beasts, you can choose to summon a swarm instead of individual creatures.

cards.name: Fire Affinity
cards.effect: Resistance fire and additional produce flame cantrip. No immunity to smoke/suffocation or supernatural heat beyond resistance.

source.originalText:
Fire Affinity
When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you gain resistance to fire damage. Additionally, you learn the produce flame cantrip if you don't already know it.

cards.name: Blazing Rebirth
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; ally/self 30 ft taking fire damage
cards.effect: Grant L+M temporary HP after real hostile/environmental fire damage. Cannot reduce triggering hit retroactively or trigger from deliberate ally/self-farming. Normal temporary HP nonstacking; no buffer reserve payment because finite feature use.

source.originalText:
Blazing Rebirth
Starting at 2nd level, you can channel the regenerative power of fire. When you or an ally within 30 feet of you takes fire damage, you can use your reaction to grant temporary hit points equal to your druid level + your Wisdom modifier to that creature.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

cards.name: Flame Stride
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Grove; up to 6 ground tiles traversed
cards.effect: For 3 rounds immune to nonmagical environmental fire only. Leave up to 6 total 5 ft fire tiles along movement; creatures entering/starting DEX save or 1d6 fire, once/creature/round across all tiles. Tiles end with feature; no recursive area expansion.

source.originalText:
Flame Stride
Beginning at 6th level, you can move through fire without taking damage. Additionally, when you move through a space containing fire, you can choose to leave a trail of fire behind you. Each creature that enters this fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d6 fire damage.
The fire lasts for 1 minute or until extinguished. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

cards.name: Charbear
cards.rangeAndTarget: Ashen Hero; claw 5 ft/aura 5 ft/smoke 10 ft
cards.effect: Claw 2d8+WIS fire; first hit/turn Burn 1d4 next turn. Up to 3 enemies starting 5 ft CON save or 1d6 fire. Smoke Action opaque 10 ft radius sphere centered fixed point you occupy, concentration 3 rounds; all vision blocked, no poison in this draft. Wind 20 mph disperses.

source.originalText:
Charbear
Flame Aura: Creatures within 5 ft. of you take 1d6 fire damage at the start of their turn
Fire Claw: Your claw attacks deal 2d8 fire damage
Smoke Cloud: As an action, you can create a 20-foot-radius sphere of smoke centered on yourself. The area is heavily obscured, and creatures other than you that start their turn in the smoke must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of their next turn.

cards.name: Blazewood Stag
cards.cost: One shift; blast one long-rest use
cards.effect: Antlers 1d8+WIS piercing; 20 ft charge adds 2d6 fire once/turn. Leave up to 3 fire tiles/turn, last until start next turn, DEX save or 1d8 fire once/creature/round. Blast Action 6d6 fire DEX half up to 3 creatures 10 ft, not free on reversion.

source.originalText:
Blazewood Stag
Flaming Trail: You leave a trail of fire behind you as you move. Each creature that enters this fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d8 fire damage.
Burning Charge: If you move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with a horn attack, the target takes an additional 2d6 fire damage.
Conflagration: Once per long rest, you can explode in a burst of flame. Each creature within 10 ft. of you must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

cards.name: Master of Ash
cards.cost: Plant growth normal cost and 10 minutes
cards.effect: Immune fire. Before one initial save against your fire spell impose-2, never auto failure. A paid prepared plant growth may restore ordinary vegetation in burned land within its printed area; no instant food/valuable timber, magical plants or creature creation.

source.originalText:
Master of Ash
At 14th level, you gain immunity to fire damage. Additionally, when you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one) to automatically fail their saving throws against the spell.
Furthermore, you can cast the plant growth spell to instantly restore vegetation to an area devastated by fire, causing plants to grow to full maturity within minutes rather than over the course of a year.

completeSupportSpells.name: Warding Bond

operational.targets: One willing ally other than yourself, perceived within range and line of effect. Neither participant may already participate in another Warding Bond, as caster or protected ally.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. Also ends if either participant dies. Reaching 0 HP alone is not a separate ending condition; ordinary Incapacitated/concentration rules still apply.
operational.resolution: Automatic on legal casting. On each eligible positive incoming damage packet to the ally, apply the mandatory post-defense transfer described below; a rounded-zero transfer claims no transfer operation.
operational.effect: The ally gains +1 AC and +1 to saves, subject separately to the strongest applicable flat bonus. After the ally's defenses and legal prevention, before temporary HP, transfer floor(remaining damage / 2) to you and leave the remainder on the ally. Keep the damage type. Your transferred share skips a second mitigation/prevention stage and cannot transfer again; apply your temporary HP, HP, applicable life-state protections, Wounds and concentration consequences normally. The ally retains the hit, failed-save, critical and attached-rider identity; you were not hit and did not fail that save merely because damage transferred.
operational.scaling: None. The rank-2 duplicate grants no upgrade or extra effect.
operational.limitations: Use DAMAGE_SHARING_PLAYTEST.md: one transfer operation per original-recipient damage root, across all owners. A prior pre-mitigation split preempts this transfer; competing positive mandatory post-defense claims are chosen by the original target. The retained ally portion cannot subsequently be transferred again after this split. Complete the current packet's split and life consequences before concentration failure caused by that packet ends the bond; never undo a committed share. One Warding Bond per participating creature across all casters; casting cannot create chains or cycles. Initial range/line of effect are required, but no continuing distance or line-of-effect tether is imposed. This ordinary spell neither consumes nor increases the Paladin class redirection round ledger and grants none of its named healing/resource riders or proc permissions. Unrelated downstream triggers still require their own exact source authorization. Direct HP payments are not damage and cannot be transferred. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, concentration 1 minute, +1 AC/saves and half-damage sharing; M/F uses focus. NEW: willing ally, conserved mandatory post-defense split, rounding, participation and life endpoints, no continued tether and ordinary-spell/class-engine separation. CONFLICT RULING: source-derived class access is rank 1; duplicate rank-2 block is retained as evidence only.

completeSupportSpells.name: Death Ward

operational.targets: One living creature you can perceive within range and line of effect
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; ends when its prevention is used
operational.resolution: No initial save. While the spell remains active, the first eligible effect that would reduce the target from positive HP to 0 without Core Instant Death or another outright-death result instead leaves it at 1 HP; then the ward ends.
operational.effect: Prevent one positive-to-zero HP crossing. Preserve the raw damage packet, Core Instant Death check, half-maximum/Maiming Wound triggers and attached conditions. The prevented positive-to-zero crossing does not itself create a drop-only Wound save. This is loss prevention, not healing, so a cannot-regain-HP effect does not stop it. Other eligible survival effects are rechecked after the selected prevention resolves; no duplicate automatic use is consumed after the crossing has already been prevented.
operational.scaling: None. Always one eligible crossing and a 1-HP floor.
operational.limitations: Does not trigger while the target is already at 0. Does not resurrect, repair a vital body, prevent third death-save failure/fatal Wound death/lethal-track death or override explicitly unpreventable HP loss. Cannot legalize an otherwise unaffordable HP cost. If multiple independently owned wards exist, use only the chosen eligible prevention; unused records retain their own concentration/deadline. This is distinct from Cleric Ritual of Undeath's would-die replacement. Normal spell costs and risk apply.
operational.designNotes: Core Necromancy rank4, 7RP, Action, 60ft and concentration1minute retained with exact class gates. M/F uses the already-reviewed class-focus alternative; no unstated material cost. NEW: living target, explicit positive crossing, outright-death exclusion and competing-prevention procedure. The agreed damage/HP-loss interface is in the candidate guide; reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.
